IDEA.md core novelty claim is globally FALSE as of Aug 2026. 'No self-serve path for an arbitrary merchant to become agent-transactable' is refuted by: Shopify UCP self-serve GA 17 Jun 2026 (every store auto-gets an MCP endpoint, 'no approval committee', Agentic Plan for non-Shopify brands with no monthly fee); Stripe Agentic Commerce Suite 11 Dec 2025 (upload catalog to Dashboard, pick agents, Stripe handles discovery+checkout+payments = IDEA.md steps 1-3 almost verbatim); Shoppable Universal Checkout MCP 12 May 2026 (multi-tenant catalog-to-MCP, 500M+ items, live on Claude). IDEA.md 'two-sided trust guarantee / missing integrity primitive that ACP and x402 are still figuring out' is FALSE. ACP checkout spec (stable 2026-04-17) already makes the merchant authoritative: every checkout_sessions create/update returns full authoritative cart state, so the agent never transacts on cached price. ACP also already has a Product Feed Spec (item_id, price, availability, eligibility flags, gzipped JSONL/CSV/XML, 15-min refresh). Also a category error: x402 is M2M micropayments for API access, not catalogs; AP2 is payment authorization only; NPCI UAP is 'Unified Agent Protocol' (agent identity/authorization, still pre-RBI-approval), not catalog discovery.

Two hard Razorpay API constraints found. Use the Orders API as the primary rail. (2) UPI Reserve Pay is NOT buildable: no public API reference, no test-mode sandbox, closed pilot only. The IDEA.md trade-off row citing Reserve Pay must be dropped or explicitly labelled future work — a Razorpay panel will know it is gated.

Track 01 is the ONLY track without a quantitative bar. Razorpay's engineering culture is metrics-driven (Bumblebee: merchant evaluation under 90s, ~800 hrs/month of manual review replaced, detection accuracy 88% -> 99%+). Supplying numbers voluntarily on Track 01 is therefore a cheap, high-signal differentiator. IDEA.md currently has zero metrics.

BLOCKER: a headless agent cannot AUTHORIZE a payment on a vanilla Razorpay test account. Every documented server-to-server route is gated. S2S Redirect and S2S JSON v1/v2 all carry a 'raise a request with our Support team to get this feature enabled' block, and S2S generally requires PCI-DSS certification. UPI Collect (the server-side VPA flow, success@razorpay) was DEPRECATED 28 Feb 2026 per NPCI — new users must use UPI Intent. UPI Payment Links are explicitly not supported in test mode. Smart Collect test payments are Dashboard-button-only. Standard Checkout in test mode requires clicking a mock bank page and entering an OTP in a browser. Capture is NOT the problem (auto-capture is the account default and applies to Orders-API payments); AUTHORIZATION is. Only documented headless simulate-payment endpoint is POST /v1/bharatqr/pay/test, and BharatQR itself needs a support ticket to activate.

PITCH REFRAMED: the product is the GATE, not the catalog. 'Agent-readable catalog' is Razorpay's own listed example for Track 01 and therefore the crowded framing. CROSS-TRACK GRAFT: import Track 02's bar ('honest metrics including false-positive cost') into Track 01. Treat the gate as a classifier and measure precision/recall over a held-out set of benign and adversarial agent sessions. Key insight tying the halves together: a false positive in the gate is a legitimate purchase blocked, i.e. merchant revenue lost — so false-positive cost denominated in rupees of blocked legitimate GMV is simultaneously the Track 02 honesty metric and the Track 01 GROWTH metric. Cost is a scripted session generator, not a new subsystem. Expected to be unique among Track 01 submissions.

GATE BUG, same class as the one fixed in v1, one level up. IDEA.md enforces the spend cap over session_id. An agent defeats that by opening a new SESSION, exactly as a global cap is defeated by opening a new conversation. Adversarial class #1 (budget-split evasion) is therefore trivially winnable against the defense as written, and it is the first thing a judge will ask about. Fix (~30 min, one WHERE clause): enforce over (merchant_id, agent_id, window); session_id becomes display and audit-linkage grouping only. Policy.window and Session.agent_id already exist in the data model and are currently unused. Residual to state openly: agent_id is self-asserted unless bound to the auth token — either issue per-agent credentials or write in the README that agent identity is unauthenticated in this build, which is precisely the gap NPCI's UAP exists to fill.

The metrics table is circular as designed and that makes it a liability rather than a differentiator. The same person writes the gate rules and the adversarial attacks, so the generator can only produce attacks the rule author already imagined. Precision and recall over that population measure implementation correctness against a spec, not detection capability against an adversary. A panel spots this fast. Two fixes: (1) relabel honestly as 'rule-coverage measurement over a declared threat model' and state the limitation in both README and video before a judge states it; (2) spend ~1.5hrs generating adversarial sessions from a SEPARATE Claude call whose context holds only the MCP tool schema and the merchant policy JSON, never the gate implementation — a genuinely different author, so any escape it finds is a real finding.

Two more measurement defects. (a) Train/held-out splits detect overfitting of FITTED PARAMETERS; hand-written rules have none, so the ML vocabulary implies a rigor that is not present and reads as a tell. Reframe as pre-registration and hold-out discipline: the training split is the only data looked at while tuning, the held-out split runs exactly ONCE at the end, and the README states the split was frozen before tuning. (b) False-positive cost in rupees is not defensible as 'the order total that would have been real revenue': the totals come from the builder's own seeded price distribution, blocked GMV is not lost revenue when the graceful-failure story has the agent re-plan and substitute, and GMV/merchant margin/Razorpay MDR are three different numbers. Restate as blocked benign GMV at the seeded price distribution, explicitly an upper bound, alongside a recovery rate and a net figure, and publish the price distribution so a reader can rescale.

Evaluation suite consumes DETERMINISTIC SCRIPTED TRANSCRIPTS (JSON arrays of tool calls with asserted prices and quantities), not live Claude sessions. Saves ~3hrs plus API spend, runs in seconds, is reproducible by a judge who clones the repo, and decouples the differentiator from the highest-risk task. The Claude agent becomes one hero session recorded for the video rather than a dependency of the metrics.

Evaluation suite is scheduled BEFORE both UIs, not after. Last-scheduled is first-cut, and this is the one component whose absence changes what the project is: without the metrics table it reverts to a multi-tenant catalog MCP server, which is Razorpay's own listed example for Track 01. Sample-size discipline for the metrics table: at 200 sessions / 70:30 benign:adversarial / 60:40 train:held-out, the held-out set holds roughly 24 adversarial sessions across 5 attack classes, about 5 per class, where per-rule recall carries a confidence interval near plus or minus 35 points. Report RAW CONFUSION COUNTS AS INTEGERS per rule ('4 of 5 caught'), never percentages. Reserve percentages for pooled numbers where n reaches the dozens.
